patterns.law: The Mac composer text view must own plain-text paste insertion directly; do not close a paste bug by relying only on SwiftUI commands, a main Edit menu, or implicit AppKit responder routing.

When a repeated bug depends on native/platform behavior, stop in-place patching after two failed fixes and build a throwaway minimal positive control that proves the primitive works before porting the delta back.
patterns.proof: Debugger packet must name `Clean-room baseline` and the baseline-to-product delta; future wall gate should fail repeated DEBUGLOG entries that omit it.
